lines.name: Farmer Joe
lines.text: Hey there! Can you spare a moment? My back hurts really badly — would you be so kind as to help me? See these haystacks? I need to clear them all. It shouldn’t take long.

lines.name: Farmer Joe
lines.text: Hey there! You cleared a haystack! Thanks! That’s quite funny — I was just about to ask you to help deal with the haystacks, but you’ve already taken care of them yourself. Amazing!

lines.name: Farmer Joe
lines.text: Just move them to the pit. I hope they will fit there.

lines.name: Farmer Joe
lines.text: One is done, and only one more to go!

lines.name: Farmer Joe
lines.text: One is not done, and only one more to go!

lines.name: Farmer Joe
lines.text: You did it! You are a lifesaver! My back feels so much better now. Take this tasty, shiny carrot — you deserve it

lines.name: Farmer Joe
lines.text: Hey there! Can you spare a moment? My back hurts really badly — would you be so kind as to help me? See these haystacks? I need to clear them all. It shouldn’t take long.

lines.name: Farmer Joe
lines.text: Wait a minute... Don’t say you already did it? You cleared all the haystacks? I haven’t even asked you to do it! Amazing! Take this tasty, shiny carrot — you deserve it.

lines.name: Farmer Joe
lines.text: My name is Joe, by the way. Joe the Farmer, as they call me. I work here, in this very place you're standing right now.

lines.name: Farmer Joe
lines.text: Have you met my cow? She is not here right now; I suppose she is wandering around.

lines.name: Farmer Joe
lines.text: I saw an opossum one day. Can you imagine? A real opossum here!

lines.name: Farmer Joe
lines.text: Go and look around — maybe you'll get lucky and find it. Draw a picture of it; others would love to see it.

lines.name: Farmer Joe
lines.text: Ahh... The weather is so yellow today, isn’t it?

lines.name: Farmer Joe
lines.text: Sunny but not too hot. A light breeze is blowing, whistling in my ears. I love it!

lines.name: Farmer Joe
lines.text: I just wish I could go around and see what’s happening in the village instead of standing here all day.

lines.name: Farmer Joe
lines.text: You can go or stay. I don’t mind your company. There is plenty of work to do if you wish to join.

lines.name: Farmer Joe
lines.text: The day is so yellow. The wind is so nice.

lines.name: Farmer Joe
lines.text: I don't remember how I ended up here. Maybe I was looking for my cow? Could she be hiding somewhere in the tall grass?

lines.name: Farmer Joe
lines.text: I'll have to check the tall grass. Maybe I'll find her there.

lines.name: Farmer Joe
lines.text: I feel... hollow. My cow is gone.

lines.name: Farmer Joe
lines.text: This grass, it’s too much—it’s a wall of green, a damn jungle. I’m standing here like a fool, and I can't find her. Not even a low or a rustle.

lines.name: Farmer Joe
lines.text: Ah, there she is. I see her now, and my soul is at peace... though something still feels off.

lines.name: Farmer Joe
lines.text: Don't rightly know how I ended up here. Might've just wandered in on autopilot, bone weary as I am. But my cow... she's here. That's all that matters. My soul can rest easy now.

lines.name: Farmer Joe
lines.text: I'm just resting here. I'm tired of looking for my cow. Who knows where I will be next time?
